words.definition: producing a lot of good or useful results
words.translation: 有生產力的；富有成效的
words.example: The team had a productive meeting and finalized the schedule.
words.exampleTranslation: 團隊開了一場有成效的會議，敲定了時程。
words.note: 相關詞：productivity (n.) 生產力，例如 The new software increased our productivity significantly。

words.definition: a cold dish of mixed vegetables or other ingredients
words.example: The cafeteria offers a fresh salad bar at lunch.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工餐廳午餐時段有新鮮的沙拉吧。
words.note: 常見搭配動詞 toss，例如 toss a salad（拌沙拉）

words.definition: a neat pile of things placed one on top of another
words.example: There's a stack of invoices waiting for your signature.
words.exampleTranslation: 有一疊發票等著你簽名。
words.note: stack 也可當動詞用，例如 stack the chairs in the corner（把椅子疊放在角落）

words.definition: a person whose job is to sell products or services
words.example: The salesperson explained the warranty options in detail.
words.exampleTranslation: 那位銷售員詳細說明了保固方案。
words.note: 性別中立用詞，取代較舊的 salesman/saleswoman

words.definition: a device used to perform mathematical calculations
words.example: Keep a calculator handy when reviewing the budget spreadsheet.
words.exampleTranslation: 檢查預算表時，手邊放一台計算機比較方便。
words.note: 動詞形：calculate (v.) 計算，例如 Let me calculate the total cost。

words.definition: the act of finishing something
words.example: The project is expected to reach completion by the end of the quarter.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個專案預計在本季末完成。
words.note: 動詞形：complete (v.) 完成，例如 We need to complete the report by Friday。

words.definition: a fault or imperfection in something
words.example: The factory found a defect in the last batch of parts.
words.exampleTranslation: 工廠在最後一批零件裡發現了瑕疵。
words.note: 也可作動詞（重音在後，defECT），意思是「叛逃」，例如 The scientist defected to another country。

words.definition: waste material that is thrown away
words.example: Please take out the garbage before you leave the office.
words.exampleTranslation: 離開辦公室前請把垃圾拿出去丟。
words.note: 常見於 garbage truck（垃圾車）這個複合詞

words.definition: to leave something out or not include it
words.example: Don't omit your contact information from the application.
words.exampleTranslation: 申請表上請不要漏掉你的聯絡資訊。
words.note: 字尾雙寫 t：omitted, omitting（重音在字尾且母音+子音結尾要雙寫）

words.definition: used in the phrase 'in spite of' to mean despite
words.example: In spite of the delay, the shipment arrived in good condition.
words.exampleTranslation: 儘管有延誤，這批貨還是完好送達了。
words.note: 常用片語 in spite of（儘管）

words.definition: a room containing a toilet and sink
words.example: The bathroom on this floor is currently being cleaned.
words.exampleTranslation: 這層樓的洗手間目前正在清潔中。
words.note: 美式英語習慣稱洗手間為 bathroom，英式英語較常用 toilet

words.definition: a taxi
words.example: I'll take a cab to the airport to save time.
words.exampleTranslation: 我會搭計程車去機場以節省時間。
words.note: 同義詞 taxi，cab 是 taxicab 的簡稱

words.definition: letters or emails exchanged between people
words.example: Please keep a record of all correspondence with the vendor.
words.exampleTranslation: 請保留與供應商之間所有往來信件的紀錄。
words.note: 動詞形：correspond (v.) 通信；相符，例如 Please correspond with the vendor directly。

words.definition: a structure used for climbing up or down, or a metaphor for career progress
words.example: She worked her way up the corporate ladder over ten years.
words.exampleTranslation: 她花了十年時間一步步爬上公司的職涯階梯。
words.note: 英式英語中 ladder 也指絲襪抽絲（美式英語稱為 run）

words.definition: the art or practice of taking photographs
words.example: The company hired a professional for the product photography.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司請了專業人士來拍攝產品攝影照。
words.note: 相關詞：photographer (n.) 攝影師，例如 We hired a photographer for the event。

words.definition: a work of art made by carving or shaping material
words.example: A large sculpture stands in front of the corporate headquarters.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司總部前面立著一座大型雕塑。
words.note: 相關詞：sculptor (n.) 雕塑家，例如 The sculptor unveiled her latest work。

words.definition: the date on which an event took place in a previous year
words.example: The store is celebrating its tenth anniversary with a sale.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間店正在以特賣慶祝十週年紀念。
words.note: 常見於 wedding anniversary（結婚週年紀念日）這個複合詞

words.definition: a meal where guests serve themselves from dishes laid out on a table
words.example: Lunch will be a buffet in the hotel's main hall.
words.exampleTranslation: 午餐將在飯店大廳以自助餐形式供應。
words.note: 餐飲用法的 buffet 字尾 t 不發音（法語借詞），勿與動詞 buffet「連續撞擊」搞混

words.definition: having a fault; not working correctly
words.example: Customers can return any defective merchandise for a full refund.
words.exampleTranslation: 顧客可以退還任何有瑕疵的商品並獲得全額退款。
words.note: 相關詞：defect (n.) 瑕疵，例如 The inspector found a defect in the product。

words.definition: a frozen sweet food made from cream
words.example: The cafeteria added a new ice cream flavor this month.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工餐廳這個月新增了一種冰淇淋口味。
words.note: 通常為不可數名詞，但點餐時可數，例如 I'll have an ice cream。
